summary: Verified the 'Use my live Exit Engine settings' toggle end-to-end on backend + WEB + MOBILE. Backend PDF confirms LIVE mode -> 'Exit method used: Live Exit Engine (deployed config)' + 'Exit settings: Live Exit Engine (deployed config)'; MANUAL mode -> 'Exit settings: Manual override (selected for this run)'. Run docs have exit_source='live'/'manual' and exit_method='engine'/'atr'. WEB (StrategyValidationPanel dialog, track A · Current Prod): toggle present with correct testIDs (use-live-exit-toggle, use-live-exit-switch), DEFAULT ON (data-state=checked), manual EXIT STRATEGY (native/atr/fixed) hidden when ON, reappears when OFF, hides again on re-ON. MOBILE (Research › Validate): wiz-live-exit-row + wiz-use-live-exit present, DEFAULT ON, wiz-exit-atr/wiz-exit-fixed hidden when ON and appear when OFF (verified via screenshot + DOM). No regressions observed on the rest of the Validate flow (strategy selection, period segmented, run + results/runs-list still render). Test data cleaned up via DELETE /api/lab/runs/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: StrategyValidationPanel.jsx line 213: when useLive=true the spec payload drops exit_method/target_profit/target_loss/atr_params (correct — backend derives them). However common.exit_method still defaults to 'atr' via useState, so if the user toggles ON without changing anything the client no longer sends it — this is intentional but easy to break during refactors; consider extracting the LIVE payload builder into a named helper (buildLiveSpec) with a comment.

Web dialog page emits a React hydration console error: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from MonteCarloPanel.jsx line 56 (unrelated to this feature). Not blocking, but worth cleaning up in a subsequent iteration.
seed_data_creation: Two temp lab runs were created & deleted during backend confirmation. No stale test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF endpoint is /api/lab/runs/{id}/pdf (NOT /report.pdf). Extract PDF text with pdfplumber (strings alone won't work — compressed streams). On WEB: to reach the StrategyValidationPanel you must (1) OWNER LOGIN via [data-testid=owner-email-input]/owner-password-input, (2) go to /research via bottom-nav-research, (3) dismiss any Welcome/Start Exploring overlay before clicking things, (4) expand [data-testid=research-advanced-toggle], (5) click [data-testid=run-validation-btn] to open the dialog. Toggle IDs: use-live-exit-toggle (label), use-live-exit-switch (Radix Switch — read data-state=checked/unchecked). On MOBILE: after login there is a 'Coming Soon to Ananta' welcome sheet — click 'Continue to Cockpit' to dismiss, then tap [data-testid=tab-research]. Toggle IDs: wiz-live-exit-row, wiz-use-live-exit (RN Switch renders as a DIV in web preview — click to toggle; verify via presence/absence of [data-testid=wiz-exit-atr] which is the manual segmented). Manual segmented: [data-testid=wiz-exit-atr] and [data-testid=wiz-exit-fixed]. Default is always ON.
